verdict.rationale: Obsidian's official docs have a dedicated Community plugins page about extending the app with community-built plugins for features like extra file formats or third-party integrations (obsidian-docs-7, obsidian-docs-31). Plugins are gated behind a default Restricted Mode, which implies an install flow for third-party code (obsidian-docs-27). Users name several community plugins they rely on for things the core app lacks, such as Text-Generator, Copilot, Ink and Dataview (obsidian-comm-6, obsidian-comm-13, obsidian-comm-15, obsidian-comm-16, obsidian-comm-10). Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an in-app browsable catalog and one-click install flow, and any quantification showing the catalog is large.
